name: SNS Backward Pass with Intermediate Variable Q
aliases: SNS Backward Pass with Intermediate Variable Q — SNS Gradient Computation
definition: To avoid complex coupling between rotation $R$ and scale $S$ in the gradient computation, an intermediate variable $Q = ARS$ is introduced, where $A$ is the projection matrix.
summary: The SNS Backward Pass with Intermediate Variable Q computes exact gradients for 3D Skew-Normal Splatting by decoupling rotation and scale interactions via an intermediate shape matrix, enabling direct closed-form gradient computation.
